items.title: OUST Q3 Earnings Call Highlights REV8 Demand and Robotics Growth
items.summary: Ouster (OUST) reported Q3 2026 earnings that beat estimates with a 20-cent loss per share versus 30-cent consensus, and revenues of $59.3 million exceeding $56.2 million guidance. The company highlighted strong demand for its REV8 lidar sensors, plans to expand annual manufacturing capacity beyond 100,000 units by end of 2027, and momentum in Stereolabs cameras. Q4 guidance projects $61-64 million in revenues with approximately 48% year-over-year growth expected for 2026.

items.title: Ouster, Inc. (OUST) Suffers a Larger Drop Than the General Market: Key Insights
items.summary: Ouster, Inc. (OUST) declined 2% to $32.79, underperforming the S&P 500's 0.45% loss. The stock has plummeted 30.48% over the past month, significantly lagging its sector. While revenue is projected to grow 42.17% year-over-year to $56.2 million, the company maintains a negative EPS outlook of -$0.3. Ouster currently holds a Zacks Rank of #4 (Sell).
